summary: One behavior: place the tier-4 organisms in the production world data on the private roster's bands, closing the roster, and prove it with the two roster-wide FINAL PROOFS ST-03 named this item owner of - the whole-roster world-data check (15+ active types, section 11.1 band distribution, every id resolves, every spawn in its designed band; AC-roster-count) and the roster-wide per-species test-existence check plus spoiler audit of every ST-03 commit and artifact (AC-roster-tests). The proofs are cross-child verification obligations, not extra product behaviors: scope is explicitly placement-and-proof only, with no creature behavior or renderer changes, and any defect found is routed through the existing fix-planning route rather than fixed here. Two named changed subsystems (world content data, headless scenario tests), both genuinely changed. Criteria AC-roster-count and AC-roster-tests are retained verbatim from WI-03d and their union with siblings covers all three parent criteria. Depends on WI-03d1 and WI-03d2 correctly; the handoff points a fresh session to the story plan's proof ownership, request sections 11.1/33/68/70/74, WI-01b ids and bands, the earlier tiers' landed ids, and design_private, so no project reconstruction is needed.
